findings.evidence: The current B-page `requires` list names only `generalized-bayes-loss-updates-and-temperature`. Its example items depend on `lem-countable-discrete-space-is-standard-borel`, housed on `dirichlet-process-priors-and-finite-partition-updates`; the coverage counterexample also depends on `def-confidence-set-and-coverage`, housed on `confidence-sets-pivots-and-test-inversion`. Both prerequisite pages are declared by the batch-22 manifest but absent from the current `requires` list.

The summary says, “Each calculation states its finite experiment and update hypotheses locally.” `ex-loss-update-can-have-infinite-normalizer` instead uses the countably infinite space `Theta = N` with a fixed-observation loss and no sampling experiment. `ex-rescaling-loss-changes-effective-temperature` also specifies a finite prior and loss but no statistical experiment. The universal summary claim is false.
